set.name: Set
set.tip: Set the target variable to the expression’s value

add.name: Add
add.tip: Add the value of the expression to the target variable's value

sub.name: Sub
sub.tip: Subtract the value of the expression from the target variable's value

mul.name: Mul
mul.tip: Multiply the target variable's value by the value of the expression

div.name: Div
div.tip: Divide the target variable's value by the value of the expression

mod.name: Mod
mod.tip: Get the remainder when the target variable's value is divided by the value of the expression

mod.name: Mod
mod.tip: Get the remainder when operands are divided

mod().name: (Mod)
mod().tip: Get remainder when operands are divided (higher priority)

setNumber-operand-type.label: Type
setNumber-operand-type.tip: Select the method to obtain the value

list.name: List Item
list.tip: Read the list from a variable, then read the value at a specified position in the list

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.tip: Parameters entered in 'Show Text' or 'Show Choices' commands

script.name: Script
script.tip: Execute JavaScript and get the return value

setNumber-operand-math-method.label: Math Method
setNumber-operand-math-method.tip: Select a mathematical method to retrieve a value

round.name: Round
round.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the nearest integer after rounding

floor.name: Floor
floor.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the largest integer less than or equal to this number

ceil.name: Ceil
ceil.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to this number

sqrt.name: Sqrt
sqrt.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the square root of this number

abs.name: Abs
abs.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the absolute value of this number

cos.name: Cos
cos.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the cosine of this angle

sin.name: Sin
sin.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the sine of this angle

tan.name: Tan
tan.tip: Reads the variable value and returns the tangent of this angle

random.name: Random[0,1)
random.tip: Returns a random number between 0 and less than 1

random-int.name: Random Int
random-int.tip: Returns a random integer between the specified minimum and maximum values

distance.name: Distance
distance.tip: Returns the distance between two positions

distance-x.name: Horizontal Distance
distance-x.tip: Returns the horizontal distance between two positions

distance-y.name: Vertical Distance
distance-y.tip: Returns the vertical distance between two positions

relative-angle.name: Relative Angle
relative-angle.tip: Returns the relative angle between two positions

setNumber-operand-string-method.label: String Method
setNumber-operand-string-method.tip: Select a string method to retrieve a value

length.name: Get Length
length.tip:
Get the number of characters in the string.
For example: "abcd" returns 4

parse.name: Parse Number
parse.tip:
Parse a string to a number.
For example: "12.34" returns 12.34

search.name: Get Index of Search String
search.tip:
Search for the position of the substring in the string.
For example: in "abcdefg"
Search for "abc" and the result is 0
Search for "cdef" and the result is 2.
Search for "h" and the result is -1, meaning it does not exist.

Angle corresponding to actor animation direction.

Two directions may be 0/180
Four directions may be 0/90/180/270

trigger-button.name: Event Mouse Button
trigger-button.tip:
Get the button code of the currently triggered "mouse event"
0: Left button
1: Middle button
2: Right button
3: Back button
4: Forward button

trigger-wheel-y.name: Event Wheel Delta Y
trigger-wheel-y.tip:
Get the DeltaY of the currently triggered "wheel event"
Less than 0: Slide up
Greater than 0: Slide down

trigger-gamepad-button.name: Event Gamepad Button
trigger-gamepad-button.tip:
Get the button code of the currently triggered "gamepad event"
Valid values: 0/1/2/3...
Invalid value: -1

gamepad-left-stick-angle.name: Gamepad Left Stick Angle
gamepad-left-stick-angle.tip:
Get the left stick angle of the currently triggered "gamepad event"
0 degrees = right, rotates clockwise
Valid values: [0, 360)
Invalid value: -1

gamepad-right-stick-angle.name: Gamepad Right Stick Angle
gamepad-right-stick-angle.tip:
Get the right stick angle of the currently triggered "gamepad event"
0 degrees = right, rotates clockwise
Valid values: [0, 360)
Invalid value: -1

mouse-screen-x.name: Mouse Screen X
mouse-screen-x.tip: Horizontal position of the mouse in the screen in pixels

mouse-screen-y.name: Mouse Screen Y
mouse-screen-y.tip: Vertical position of the mouse in the screen in pixels

mouse-ui-x.tip:

mouse-ui-y.name: Mouse UI Y

Vertical position of the mouse within the root element in pixels
Mouse UI Y = Mouse Screen Y / UI Scale

mouse-scene-y.name: Mouse Scene Y

Horizontal position of the touch within the root element in pixels
Touch UI X = Touch Screen X / UI Scale

touch-ui-y.name: Touch UI Y

Vertical position of the touch within the root element in pixels
Touch UI Y = Touch Screen Y / UI Scale

touch-scene-y.name: Touch Scene Y

virtual-axis-x.name: Virtual Axis X
virtual-axis-x.tip:
Horizontal distance from point to center of unit circle
Affected by left and right arrow keys
Range: [-1, 1]

virtual-axis-y.name: Virtual Axis Y
virtual-axis-y.tip:
Vertical distance from point to center of unit circle
Affected by up and down arrow keys
Range: [-1, 1]

virtual-axis-angle.name: Virtual Axis Angle
virtual-axis-angle.tip:
Angle from center to virtual axis (X, Y)
Set to invalid value after entering dead zone
0 degrees = right, rotates clockwise
Valid range: [0, 360)
Invalid value: -1

start-position-x.name: Start Position X

start-position-y.name: Start Position Y
start-position-y.tip: Set via "Scene Stage -> Context Menu -> Set Initial Position"

camera-x.name: Camera X
camera-x.tip: Horizontal position of the center of the camera

camera-y.name: Camera Y
camera-y.tip: Vertical position of the center of the camera

camera-zoom.name: Camera Zoom
camera-zoom.tip: Final camera zoom ratio (raw zoom * scene scale)

raw-camera-zoom.name: Raw Camera Zoom
raw-camera-zoom.tip: Camera's own zoom ratio (not affected by scene scale)

scene-width.name: Scene Width
scene-width.tip: Number of horizontal grids in scene

scene-height.name: Scene Height
scene-height.tip: Number of vertical grids in scene

play-time.name: Play Time
play-time.tip: Player's total play time; saved and cleared on game reset.

elapsed-time.name: Elapsed Time
elapsed-time.tip: Running time since game start; cleared after exit

delta-time.name: Delta Time
delta-time.tip:
Elapsed time between previous frame end and current frame start (ms),
e.g. 16.66 at 60FPS. If game speed is 2, delta time scales to 33.33ms

timestamp.name: Get Timestamp
timestamp.tip: Generate a number for recording the current date in this computer

party-version.name: Party Version
party-version.tip: It is incremented when party members change

actor-count.name: Number of Actors in the Scene
actor-count.tip: Number of actors in the specified team in current scene

latest-item-increment.name: Latest Item Increment
latest-item-increment.tip: Refreshed when any actor gains items, used to read the number of items gained

latest-money-increment.name: Latest Money Increment
latest-money-increment.tip: Refreshed when any actor gains money, used to read the number of money gained

loader-loaded-bytes.name: Loader - Loaded Bytes
loader-loaded-bytes.tip: Counts the loaded bytes of all files being loaded in the background

loader-total-bytes.name: Loader - Total Bytes
loader-total-bytes.tip: Counts the total bytes of all files being loaded in the background

loader-completion-progress.name: Loader - Completion Progress
